Services

Six lines of defence

From eyes on the water to capture and relocation — wildlife-risk controls matched to your site, your crew and your approvals.

On site

Where each line works

Six services, each covering a different part of the risk — from the water’s edge to the site office.

  1. 1Crocodile Capture & RelocationOn the water — the last resort when a crocodile can’t be managed in place
  2. 2Crocodile Spotting & Safety OverwatchOn the bank — eyes on the water while crews work
  3. 3Fauna Spotter Catcher ServicesBeside the machinery — snakes and fauna during clearing
  4. 4Feral Animal ManagementIn the surrounding land — licensed control programs
  5. 5Crocodile & Snake Awareness TrainingWith the crew — toolbox talks and site briefings
  6. 6Wildlife ConsultingIn the site office — SOPs, SWMS and risk assessments
01

Crocodile Capture & Relocation

When other controls are impractical, we trap and relocate problem crocodiles — assessed case by case and fully permitted.

Explore service →02

Crocodile Spotting & Safety Overwatch

Trained operators watch the water and banks so crews can work near croc habitat with eyes on every threat.

Explore →03

Fauna Spotter Catcher Services

Onsite snake and fauna capture and relocation for construction, infrastructure, mining and environmental works.

Explore →04

Feral Animal Management

Licensed, insured feral animal control programs across the Northern Territory.

Explore →05

Crocodile & Snake Awareness Training

Onsite training, toolbox talks and site briefings that keep crews croc-wise and snake-safe.

Explore →06

Wildlife Consulting

SOP and SWMS development, captive husbandry advice and specialist training for parks, zoos and government agencies.

Our approach

Assess. Plan. Control. Brief.

Assess

Site visit, habitat review and a clear read of the wildlife risk.

Plan

SOPs and SWMS written for your site, your crew and your permits.

Control

Overwatch, spotter catchers or capture — matched to the risk.

Brief

Toolbox talks and training so crews stay croc-wise.
